ms.promise:
Updates to the ytxp-lib (https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/ytxp-lib) for supporting Conway features including:
・We will add V3 support:
・We will update the Yielding script to support PlutusV3.
・We will support other Script Purposes:
・We will update the Yielding script to allow Certifying.
・We will update the Yielding script to allow Voting.
・We will update the Yielding script to allow Proposing. 
・We will add Selective compilation:
・We will update script export to allow passing in a list of script purposes in order to perform selective compilation of the yielding script only including the ones requested by the user.
・We will add documentation for this new option in the CLI tool component included in the ytxp-lib - link to the CLI implementation : https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/ytxp-lib/blob/master/ytxp-plutarch/app/export/Main.hs.
ms.criteria:
・V3 support is added:
・The yielding script is updated to V3, and this is demonstrated in the test suite.
・Other Script Purposes are Supported:
・Tests show the yielding script is triggered at least once by Certifying
・Tests show the yielding script is triggered at least once by Voting
・Tests show the yielding script is triggeres at least once by Proposing
・Selective compilation support has been added:
・Script export via the CLI is updated to support selective compilation of the yielding script
・Documentation has been extended to describe this new feature

ms.promise:
・Update Ply to support PlutusV3 types and CIP 57 in the mlabs-haskell/ply repository.
・Add the ability to encode typed scripts in JSON compliant with CIP 57 and decode them using tools for Haskell and CTL (Purescript).
・Develop an argument application mechanism that utilizes the added Ply types and schemas.
・Perform and add tests covering encoding/decoding, argument application, and tests for PlyArgOf (unit and property tests).
・Write a generic schema description for user-defined types with minimal user input added.
・Add a user guide document.
・Produce the project closure report.
・Produce a project closure video.
ms.criteria:
・Ply now supports PlutusV3 types and the JSON schema outlined in CIP 57
・Ply can write CIP 57 conforming typed scripts that can be read by CIP 57 parsers and Ply tools such as CTL, and Atlas.
・The argument application uses Ply types and schemas
・All tests in the test suite involving encoding/decoding, argument application, and PlyArgOf tests, pass without errors.
・Generic derivation works for arbitrary user-defined data types that can be encoded into Plutus Core.
・User guide document covers fundamental usage and an overview of new features added.
・Final closeout report adheres to the guideline
